verdict.rationale: Ghostty is configured through a configuration file with hundreds of options. That file can be split into multiple files via the `config-file` key and reloaded at runtime. Community posts show plain `key = value` lines (e.g. `window-theme = system`), and custom themes are user-authored, all of which suits dotfiles management. Missing for 10: documented config file location/path conventions, explicit guidance on per-OS or conditional config for syncing across macOS and Linux (whose default bindings differ), and hands-on reports of dotfiles-based sync.
